subject: science
title: Structure of the atom
instruction: Move each label to the right part of the atom.
intro: Everything is made of atoms. Let's label the parts of one.

targets.label: Nucleus
targets.say: The nucleus is the tiny, heavy centre of the atom.

targets.label: Proton (+)
targets.say: Protons are in the nucleus and carry a positive charge.

targets.label: Neutron
targets.say: Neutrons are in the nucleus and have no charge.

targets.label: Electron (−)
targets.say: Electrons move around the nucleus and carry a negative charge.

targets.label: Shell (orbit)
targets.say: Electrons move in shells, also called orbits or energy levels.
